raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "the user"
  role location "Wrocław"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "the user's sister"
  role location "Poznań"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?who
  where all
    match
      relation "be close to"
      role subject ?who
      role destination "Berlin"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      role subject ?who
      compare ?distance below ?other_distance
    end
  end
